apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4 Debug
apps.localizedDescription: Native PQ 10-bit conversion, Metal 4 MetalFX spatial scaling and PQ presentation now share one Metal 4 command buffer for real HDR frames with sharpening off. Preserves 4:4:4; fixes saturated BT.2020 scaler-clamp clipping and clarifies No upscale status. Other inputs retain GPU interoperability and existing features. H.264 remains SDR; strict ten-bit 4:4:4 uses native H.265. 189 simulator tests and Apple M5 GPU checks passed. Unsigned experimental build; device performance comparison needed.
